name: About — principles
description: Numbered list of design principles. Each item: heading + body. Numbering is auto (01, 02, 03 …).

items.body: Not as a "ChatGPT integration." As primary operators with the same API surface humans use.
items.heading: AI agents are first-class users.

items.body: Sub-50ms TTFB on every public page. Always.
items.heading: Performance is non-negotiable.

items.body: If disabling a feature would leave dead code in core, that feature belongs in an extension.
items.heading: The kernel stays small.

items.body: Their tables, their UI, their scripts, their migrations. The kernel doesn't reach inside.
items.heading: Extensions are sovereign.

items.body: docker compose up and you're publishing. No package managers, no cron jobs, no PHP-FPM tuning.
items.heading: One-shot setup.
